svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-polo-female","name":"Women's CAP dark blue polo, short sleeves, no pocket, worn out over a medium gray skirt (embroidery positions only)","size_in":{"w":21.964,"h":32.93},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2196.4,3293],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Silhouette traced from CAPR 39-1 Figure 5.5 (3 March 2020, p.80; base-art/ref_polo_CAPR_fig5-5.png, PDF page 108 rendered at 300 dpi, trace-polo.js: shirt-only mask, left half mirrored, Moore trace, RDP 1.1 px). Scale 0.03495 in per figure pixel: the same embroidered seal is 83.9 px across (equal-area circle) in this figure and 94.9 px (2.93 in) in the men's figure, so the women's figure is drawn 1.131 times larger on the page. ESTIMATE: the regulation gives no garment dimension and the figure is a schematic drawing (its waist, 11.1 in flat, is narrower than a real polo's; the Class B blouse sheet's is 12.2 in). Shirt colour #171b1f (shadow #0f1215, highlight #1d2228), sampled in-browser from the Vanguard product photo of the CAP uniform golf shirt with seal (male, not personalized), SKU CAP0320, https://www.vanguardmil.com/cdn/shop/files/CAP0321_1.jpg (1024 x 1024); shirt pixels = every pixel with max channel < 140 and blue >= red and >= green, n = 458,157 of 1,048,576, sorted by luminance; percentiles p5 #0f1317, p25 #14181b, p50 #181c1f, p75 #1a1f24, p95 #1d242d; means: shadow p0-p10 #0f1215, body p30-p70 #171b1f, lit face p60-p90 #1a1f23, lit p85-p97 #1d2228; one photo, so estimated. Body = the p30-p70 mean, highlight lines = the p85-p97 mean, shadow / outline = the p0-p10 mean. Replaces the Figure 5.5 drawing's #001b52, which was too saturated. Belt #201a18, trousers #746f6c, skirt #86827e are sampled from the Figure 5.5 drawing (the photo set does not show them).","anchors":{"top_center":[1098.2,0],"bottom_center":[1098.2,3293],"center":[1098.2,1646.5],"left_edge":[0,1646.5],"right_edge":[2196.4,1646.5],"shoulder_seam_right":[252.41,331.54],"shoulder_seam_left":[1943.99,331.54],"collar_apex":[1098.2,560.5],"hem_center":[1098.2,2879.4],"hat_attach":[1098.2,10],"button_1_center":[1098.2,674.05],"button_2_center":[1101.69,960.64],"placket_top_center":[1098.2,565.71],"seal_center":[689.98,672.65],"name_center":[1541.37,723.68],"badge_center":[1541.37,597.46],"print_seal_center":[1506.42,672.65]},"landmarks":{"collar_right":[[1398.8,24],[1594.5,464.3],[1381.3,481.8],[1098.2,565.7]],"collar_left":[[797.6,24],[601.9,464.3],[815.1,481.8],[1098.2,565.7]],"placket":{"x":1028.3,"y":565.7,"w":139.8,"h":569.7},"seal_slot":{"x":689.98,"y":672.65,"w_in":2.93,"h_in":2.93},"name_slot":{"x":1541.37,"y":723.68,"w_in":4.2,"h_in":0.38},"badge_slot":{"x":1541.37,"y":597.46,"w_in":1.2,"h_in":1.14,"gap_to_name_in":0.5},"print_seal_slot":{"x":1506.42,"y":672.65,"w_in":2.93,"h_in":2.93},"pen_pocket_slot":{"x":2003.66,"y":801.54,"w_in":1.4,"h_in":5.5,"angle_deg":0.2,"flap_in":1.35},"hat_view":{"front":{"x":698.2,"y":-665,"w":800,"h":700},"back":{"x":1548.2,"y":-475,"w":800,"h":510}}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} (top-left); polygons are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box. The *_slot entries that carry w_in / h_in are {x,y} = the CENTRE of the slot in user units, w_in / h_in in inches. seal_slot: embroidered CAP seal, wearer's RIGHT breast (the picture's left), w_in = the figure-measured seal (2.93 in; the insignia-cap-seal asset is 2.50 in, CAPR 39-1 Fig A6-4: the figure draws the polo seal larger, the engine places the asset at the slot centre). pen_pocket_slot: the tactical polo's pen pocket on the wearer's LEFT sleeve (the picture's right), {x,y} its centre, w_in x h_in its size (1.4 x 5.5 in, estimate), angle_deg the SVG rotate() that turns an upright box onto the sleeve's axis, flap_in the flap depth. name_slot: the embroidered name line on the wearer's LEFT breast, w_in = 4.2 in (the same line length as the men's sheet; Figure 5.5 draws a 3.3 in name), h_in = the figure's cap height. badge_slot: centre of the badge / duty title line, h_in 1.14 (the figure's badge), 1/2 in above the name_slot top (CAPR 39-1 5.3.2.1.1; the figure draws 0.65 in), w_in nominal. print_seal_slot: the screen-printed CAP seal (5.3.1.2) on the wearer's LEFT breast, the seal_slot mirrored about the centre line. collar_left / collar_right name the leaf on the PICTURE's left / right (as the Class B sheets do); shoulder_seam_right / left and every anchor named left / right are the WEARER's (right = the picture's left). hat_view {front, back}: where the cap assets hat-baseball-cap-blue and hat-baseball-cap-blue-back sit (their boxes, bottoms 0.25 in below the collar-tip line, the back view 0.5 in to the picture's right of the front);
